blocks.content: The Lok Sabha passed the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development (Amendment) Bill, 2026, on 7 August 2026 during a 16-minute sitting. The Rajya Sabha had cleared the same Bill on 3 August 2026 by voice vote. The Bill relates to delayed payments, dispute resolution, and digital invoice settlement for the MSME sector.

items: The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006 is the principal law governing MSMEs in India.
TReDS stands for Trade Receivables Discounting System.
The Reserve Bank of India regulates the TReDS platform in India.
Central Public Sector Enterprises are government-owned companies under the Union Government.
